cases.title: Production refuses to start without a verifier when identity is needed
cases.when: Production mode with a tool declaring a claim, a USER secret, TOKEN_EXCHANGE auth or DELEGATED_USER, and no TOOLGATE_AUTH_* configuration
then: Startup fails with CONFIGURATION for each

cases.title: Over stdio identity tools return CLAIMS_UNAVAILABLE
cases.when: A production stdio server receives a call to a claim-declaring tool

cases.title: HTTP without a valid token gets 401
cases.when: A production HTTP server receives a request without a token and with an invalid one

cases.title: Client tools without device services are refused
cases.when: A standalone runtime starts with a client tool and no endpoint device services

cases.title: Development mode must be explicit and local
cases.when: TOOLGATE_MODE unset, then development with a non-loopback bind, then development naming a production issuer, then development on loopback
then: Non-loopback or production issuer: startup refused
Loopback: warning banner and every result marked identity=fixture

cases.title: Fixture claims are never accepted in production
cases.when: dev.json claims are present in production
then: A startup warning; claims ignored; claim tools behave as with no identity

cases.title: test mode exists only inside ToolHarness
cases.when: TOOLGATE_MODE=test is set for a runtime entry point
then: The entry point refuses to start

cases.title: Claims never come from arguments, headers or env
cases.when: Claims are supplied in arguments, X-User headers and environment variables

cases.title: Standalone prints that there is no enterprise audit
then: The banner says audit is local only

cases.title: Verifier env variables configure A4
then: Startup fails; none and HMAC are always rejected
